descriptions.preferred: 庞克是 是由韩国人育种并推广的 细叶 品种 ，类似于 "Red Pygmy"（红色霹雳），但庞克叶子更长更窄一些。它有 风之翼的美称，叶子呈竹叶状 ， 3 到 5 叶裂，叶裂狭窄细长和竹叶 相似。春叶深红色，光照充足情况下会变成紫红色，色彩可以保持到夏天。夏季遮荫情况下，会适当返绿。秋天变成鲜红色。庞克来自于 A. palmatum f. atropurpureum的幼苗，它的名字曾被错误的拼写成 "Pung Kill"。 直立性生长，但是生长速度较慢，成年树可达2 到 3米。

sources.name: Pung Kil Japanese Maple
sources.description: Pun Kil “bamboo leaf” Japanese Maple This rare maple has very thin delicate leaves mixed it with thicker leaves. The leaves emerge very dark red, holding strong color throughout the summer. grows to 7-6 ft.

rhs.description: Small, vase-shaped, slow-growing deciduous shrubby tree, about 3m tall, with 7 long, narrow strap-shaped lobed leaves, pale red in early spring becoming dark red for the summer and holding the colour well, then produces autumns tints of gold and red-purple. Inconspicuous hanging clusters of small, purple-red flowers in spring are followed by red-flushed, winged fruits

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this linearilobum group have long, narrow, strap-like lobes, with lightly serrated edges

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering in autumn, grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 庞克是 是由韩国人育种并推广的 细叶 品种 ，类似于 "Red Pygmy"（红色霹雳），但庞克叶子更长更窄一些。它有 风之翼的美称，叶子呈竹叶状 ， 3 到 5 叶裂，叶裂狭窄细长和竹叶 相似。春叶深红色，光照充足情况下会变成紫红色，色彩可以保持到夏天。夏季遮荫情况下，会适当返绿。秋天变成鲜红色。庞克来自于 A. palmatum f. atropurpureum的幼苗，它的名字曾被错误的拼写成 "Pung Kill"。 直立性生长，但是生长速度较慢，成年树可达2 到 3米。

attributes.hort_group_description: 此 linearilobum 组的槭树具有细长、带状的裂片，叶缘具浅锯齿。
attributes.suggested_uses: 适合城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、花境及花坛。

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组：仅限在晚秋至仲冬期间进行。
care.propagation: 可于秋季行压条繁殖，于晚冬进行嫁接，或采用软枝扦插繁殖。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感 Verticillium wilt、槭树叶灼病和蜜环菌。

rhs_zh.description: 小型、花瓶形、慢生的落叶灌木状小乔木，高约 3 米。叶片具 7 个细长的带状裂片，早春为浅红色，夏季转为深红，且叶色保持性好；秋季呈现金黄与红紫色秋色。春季开不显眼的小型紫红色花，成下垂簇状，之后结带红晕的翅果。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Pung kil' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Pung Kil' Rare Pung kil Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 This Korean introduction of a Japanese maple has one of the darkest foliage of the wind swept Japanese maples. We love how these thin red strap leaves flow in the wind. In the early spring, 'Pung Kil' leafs out as a deep red, which holds fairly well throughout most of the summer. Fall colors are bright oranges to crimson reds. 'Pung kil' is a slow grower reaching about 6-7 ft in 10 years. 'Pung kil' is an ideal red linearilobum Japanese maple for any yard because of its ability to hold its color well and because of the slow growth rate. Named after Mr. Pung Kil of Chollipo Arboretum in South Korea. The photo(s) with a MrMaple logo are owned by MrMaple.com and cannot be used without expressed written consent. The photos on this page without a MrMaple logo were taken by Talon Buchholz and cannot be used without expressed written consent from the owner.
